newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangchak awards Aug MTBE buy tender at $270-$275/T.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak awards Aug MTBE buy tender at $270-$275/T.

text.p: Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Plc has awarded a tender to buy 1,500 tonnes of August methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) at $270-$275 per tonne, cost-and-freight Bangkok August 16-31, a company official said on Monday.
The tender for the gasoline octane booster closed on July 17 and was valid to July 18, but Bangchak only awarded the tender late last week due to a Thai holiday, the official said.
The official declined to name the award winner.
In its last tender, Bangchak bought a cargo for July delivery at $263 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis to Thailand from Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC).
